title: Study of Pitavastatin in Elderly Patients With Primary Hypercholesterolemia or Combined Dyslipidemia
brief_summary: This is an open-label extension study of NK-104-306 (NCT00257686) for elderly patients with hypercholesterolemia or combined dyslipidemia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Greater than or equal to 65 years of age
* Primary hypercholesterolemia
* Combined dyslipidemia
* Completed study NK-104-306 (NCT00257686)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Failed to complete study NK-104-306(NCT00257686)
